attributes.board_name: Oregon Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Professional development (PD) must pass the Board's triple test (pre-approved activity type, topic and sponsor) or receive special Board approval (apply within 30 days of the event). Report PD in hours, not ASHA CEUs.
rules.audit_note: PD hours and documentation (unofficial transcripts accepted as one submission) are entered in the Licensee Portal at renewal; licensees may be selected for PD audit. Incomplete renewals or wrong PD amounts cost a $150 delinquent fee.

topics.who: SLPs who supervise speech-language pathology assistants (one-time requirement)

rules.notes: Current PD period: Jan 1, 2026 to Dec 31, 2027; all active licenses renew by Dec 31, 2027 (biennial). Dual SLP and audiology licensees need 40 hours, of which 10 may count toward both licenses. The Secretary of State rule database blocks automated access, so numbers are taken from the Board's PD page and renewal notice.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same PD rules as licensees (triple test or special Board approval).
rules.audit_note: PD reported in the Licensee Portal at renewal; subject to PD audit.
rules.notes: Speech-language pathology assistants hold a Board certification renewed every two years; current PD period Jan 1, 2026 to Dec 31, 2027.
